text:
Corporate treasury is where tokenised real-world assets stop being a concept.

On Crypto Minutes, Bloomberg TV, Re7's Founder and CIO Evgeny Gokhberg hosts Yuval Rooz, Co-Founder and CEO of Digital Asset, the company behind Canton Network, on the next phase of finance moving on-chain.

For Rooz, RWAs have always been the most compelling use case on-chain, and corporate treasury is where that becomes real:

"You're going to start seeing corporates on Canton very soon using yield products that can be liquidated in real time into tokenized deposits or stablecoins. They'll start doing treasury management using on-chain finance."

The detail worth watching is the liquidation path. Real-time conversion into tokenized deposits or stablecoins is what would let a treasury team treat an on-chain product as working capital rather than a position held apart.

Full episode linked in the comments.
